1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 10 m de altura, con tronco delgado y liso, hojas alternas compuestas de hojuelas elípticas, flores blanquecinas en espigas axilares y con vello sedoso, y fruto en legumbre; comúnmente se planta para dar sombra al café.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 10 m, with a slender and smooth trunk, alternate compound leaves composed of elliptical leaflets, whiteish flowers in axillary spikes covered with soft hair, and fruit in a legume; commonly planted to provide shade for coffee.
